tools.name: regmonitoring_search_updates
tools.description: Search regulatory updates from financial regulators across 20 jurisdictions — news, enforcement actions, consultations, policy statements, guidance, final rules, speeches and warnings, from 2011 to today. Filter by regulator, jurisdiction, topic, sector, firm type, content type, urgency, importance

tools.name: regmonitoring_get_update
tools.description: Full detail for one regulatory update, by id or slug: the AI analysis (executive summary, what changed, who is affected, actions required, key dates, compliance impact, citations), any deadline, any enforcement penalty data, and related records. Call this after regmonitoring_search_updates when you

tools.name: regmonitoring_list_deadlines
tools.description: Regulatory deadlines with dates: consultation response dates, compliance deadlines, and rule effective dates, filterable by date range, status, firm type, jurisdiction and regulator. This is the tool for "what is coming up for my firm" and for building a compliance calendar. Status is derived at que

tools.name: regmonitoring_search_enforcement
tools.description: Enforcement actions across regulators and jurisdictions, with structured penalty data where it has been parsed: entity penalised, amount, currency, breach categories, and whether the penalty is final. Use for "what has this regulator fined firms for", "has this firm been penalised", or precedent res

tools.name: regmonitoring_get_taxonomy
tools.description: Every valid filter value with the number of records carrying it: jurisdiction and regulator codes with their full names, content types, topics, sectors, firm types, urgency levels and deadline types. CALL THIS FIRST if you are unsure of any filter value. Values are exact and case-sensitive — "uk" no

tools.name: regmonitoring_get_stats
tools.description: Coverage statistics for the regmonitoring.com regulatory corpus: how many updates are indexed, the date range they span, how many regulators and jurisdictions are represented, and how many records carry AI analysis, a deadline, a penalty amount or an urgency rating. Call this before making claims ab

tools.name: regmonitoring_get_monthly_briefing
tools.description: The Reg Monitoring monthly briefing: an editor-written round-up of the most important financial services regulatory updates of one month, grouped by region (North America; UK and Europe; Asia-Pacific, Middle East and Africa), with a one-line overview per region and the deadlines in the 60 days after

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "regmonitoring_list_deadlines" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: regmonitoring_search_updates, regmonitoring_get_monthly_briefing · Private data: regmonitoring_search_updates, regmonitoring_get_update, regmonitoring_search_enforcement, regmonitoring_get_taxonomy, regmonitoring_get_stats · Public sink: regmonitoring_get_monthly_briefing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: regmonitoring_search_updates, regmonitoring_get_monthly_briefing · Private data: regmonitoring_search_updates, regmonitoring_get_update, regmonitoring_search_enforcement, regmonitoring_get_taxonomy, regmonitoring_get_stats · Public sink: regmonitoring_get_monthly_briefing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
